messages:
eva: @mike_legal heads up — Acme wants to add a subsidiary as a signing entity and they require an AML / sanctions clause in the MSA. They also want the order form e-signed with two signers (legal + finance). Any hard blockers on our side?

mike_legal: see below for quick take. we can accept an addendum but need to confirm counterparty legal entity name + tax id. AML language should be narrow (transaction screening only) — avoid open-ended warranties.

sara_procurement: finance will need the PO before we release seats. can we attach `PO: #` to the orderform and route to their AP inbox? also need billing contact.

josh_eng: technical note: private deployment POC requires a signed DPA before we share infra details. is the DPA update needed for the subsidiary too?

mike_legal: @josh_eng yes, DPA must list all entities that will process data. i'll draft an addendum that enumerates the subsidiary and ties it to the existing SOW/Order Form.

anna_cust_success: customer asked for DocuSign but said their legal prefers internal esign with HSM audit trail. do we support HSM-backed signatures for orderforms?

liam_security: security: we can support KMS/HSM-backed signing for Dedicated/Private customers. for hosted API we provide audit logs + SOC2; if they need FIPS/HSM attestation, that's an enterprise add-on. which path is Acme on?

eva: they're planning a Dedicated POC in us-west, but execs want the orderform signed today to kick off procurement. they asked if we can do an interim e-sign (DocuSign) and swap to HSM later.

mike_legal: interim DocuSign is fine as long as clause in addendum allows amendment to signature method. i'll add: `"Signature method: parties agree DocuSign acceptable until replaced by HSM-backed workflow upon mutual written agreement."`

sara_procurement: fine but finance needs invoicing entity and net terms on the orderform. can we push Net30?

eva: customer requested Net45, finance prefers Net30. open to negotiate credits for faster payment.

josh_eng: operational blocker: POC provisioning needs DPA signed before we turn on customer data access. can legal expedite? we can't share infra endpoints without it.

mike_legal: i'll mark this high priority. drafting addendum + DPA amendment today and will ping for review. can someone confirm full legal entity text and tax id from Acme?

anna_cust_success: i'll ask Acme now and get back in this thread.

eva: thanks — quick checklist for followups: 1) acme entity + tax id (anna) 2) draft addendum + DPA amend (mike) 3) e-sign route decision: DocuSign interim or HSM (liam + anna) 4) PO + billing contact (sara) 5) confirm net terms (finance)

esign-bot: created envelope 0a1b2c for `orderform-acme` (DocuSign) — awaiting signatures.

anna_cust_success: Acme confirmed entity: "Acme Industrial Holdings, Inc." EIN 12-3456789. sending billing contact now.

mike_legal: got it. i'll share a PR for the addendum in ~2 hours. tagging @sara_procurement for PO attachment language.

sara_procurement: please include this snippet on the orderform: `Billing contact: accounts-payable@acme.example.com / PO required / Net30 unless otherwise agreed`. :thumbsup:

eva: perfect. i'll hold the kickoff until we have signed orderform + DPA but ok to run the technical preflight once addendum is in review. thanks all. :wave:
